title: Domain-Specific BPS Weight Presets
description: Default and domain-tuned Build Priority Score weights for catalog-domain-capabilities.

balanced.description: General-purpose default for unknown or mixed domains

fintech.description: Financial services: regulatory/compliance weighted higher, moat lower
fintech.notes: Must-be capabilities dominate due to regulatory expectations.

healthcare.description: Healthcare/telemedicine: compliance and safety weighted highest
healthcare.notes: Indifferent capabilities may be life-critical; Kano alone is insufficient.

devtools.description: Developer tools: moat and complexity matter most
devtools.notes: Developer loyalty and ecosystem lock-in are primary differentiators.

saas-b2b.description: B2B SaaS: frequency and convergence drive enterprise sales
saas-b2b.notes: Enterprise buyers compare feature matrices; missing universal features block deals.

saas-b2c.description: B2C SaaS: Kano and convergence drive retention and delight
saas-b2c.notes: Attractive features differentiate; must-be features are hygiene.

ecommerce.description: E-commerce: conversion and trust signals weighted higher
ecommerce.notes: Checkout friction and trust signals directly impact revenue.

marketplace.description: Two-sided marketplace: network effects and trust weighted higher
marketplace.notes: Trust and safety capabilities are moat-building; speed to liquidity matters.

ai-ml.description: AI/ML products: moat and convergence velocity dominate
ai-ml.notes: Model differentiation and data moat are everything; features commoditize fast.

social.description: Social/consumer apps: Kano and network effects drive growth
social.notes: Viral mechanics and engagement loops are attractive/moat-heavy.
